title: Fabrication & Supply of 12.0m High G.I Trestle Tower for Replacement of South Button lighthouse & Construction of RCC Foundation and Erection of 12.0m High G.I Trestle Tower for Replacement of South Button lighthouse.
summary: Online percentage-rate re-tender to fabricate and supply a 12 m GI trestle tower and build its RCC foundation and erect it as a replacement for South Button lighthouse, Andaman & Nicobar Islands.

procurement.issuing_office: Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Sri Vijaya Puram (Port Blair)

sites.name: South Button Island
sites.work: Fabrication, supply and erection of 12.0m GI trestle tower on new RCC foundation to replace the lighthouse

scope.item: Fabrication & Supply of 12.0m High G.I Trestle Tower
Construction of RCC Foundation and Erection of 12.0m High G.I Trestle Tower

money.notes: Bid document free of cost. EMD by Deposit at call receipt/FDR of any nationalized/scheduled bank in favour of Director of Lighthouses and Lightships, Sri Vijaya Puram, valid 6 months from technical bid opening; originals with technical documents by post or in person by 12/08/2025 15:00. MSME/NSIC bidders registered for similar work exempt from EMD. Hindi version mentions FDR or bank guarantee.

period.bid_validity: 180 days from date of opening of technical bid

eligibility: Eligible experienced civil contractors with successful completion of similar work of construction of buildings/trestle tower in remote islands of Andaman & Nicobar with Government organizations and no adverse remarks
Detailed eligibility as per Section-III clause 3.1 of tender document (not included)
specs: 12.0 m high G.I. trestle tower on RCC foundation
